name: ListVpcEndpointConnections

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the endpoint connections that you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html operation to query the region ID.
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的终端节点连接的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:
You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query or if no next query is to be sent.
If a next query is to be sent, set the value to the value of NextToken that is returned from the last API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小。取值范围：1~1000。默认值：50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The endpoint elastic network interface (ENI) ID
parameters.name: eni_id

parameters.help_en:
The state of the endpoint connection. Valid values:

Pending: The endpoint connection is being modified.

Connecting: The endpoint connection is being established.

Connected: The endpoint is connected to the endpoint service.

Disconnecting: The endpoint is being disconnected from the endpoint service.

Disconnected: The endpoint is disconnected from the endpoint service.

Deleting: The endpoint connection is being deleted.

ServiceDeleted: The corresponding endpoint service is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点连接状态，取值：

Pending：修改中。

Connecting：连接中。

Connected：已连接。

Disconnecting：断开连接中。

Disconnected：未连接。

Deleting：删除中。

ServiceDeleted：对应的终端节点服务已删除
parameters.name: connection_status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the endpoint belongs
parameters.name: endpoint_owner_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the service resource that is replaced in the smooth migration scenario
parameters.help_zh: 平滑迁移场景下被替换的服务资源ID
parameters.name: replaced_resource_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the endpoint belongs
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的终端节点所属的资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id
